# platform-orchestrator_progressive_rollout (Data Source)

Enterprise: reads a Progressive Rollout with its current immutable Plan, approvals, conflicts, executions, audit events and aggregate metrics. Requires the Stellwerk Enterprise plugin Progressive Rollouts (`dev.stellwerk.progressive-rollouts`) to be installed, enabled and licensed for the organization. Otherwise the provider reports `plugin_not_installed`, `plugin_not_enabled`, `plugin_not_entitled`, `plugin_incompatible` or `plugin_unavailable` with the administrator action. After a licence expires, refresh, reads and the safety commands that Core still advertises (such as cancel and rollback) keep working, while new forward changes fail with `plugin_not_entitled`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "platform-orchestrator_progressive_rollout" "payments" {
  id = "6f1c2a9e-8b3d-4c5e-9f7a-1b2c3d4e5f61"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Rollout UUID.

### Read-Only

- `approvals_json` (String) Approvals of the current Plan as JSON.
- `conflicts_json` (String) Conflicts of the current Plan as JSON.
- `current_plan_revision` (Number) Current immutable numbered Plan revision, null while the Draft has not been prepared.
- `events_json` (String) Audit events as JSON.
- `executions_json` (String) Environment executions of the current Plan as JSON.
- `metrics_json` (String) Aggregate Rollout metrics as JSON.
- `name` (String) Rollout name from its spec.
- `plan_json` (String) Current immutable Plan as JSON, null before preparation.
- `resource_version` (Number) Optimistic-concurrency version.
- `spec_json` (String) ProgressiveRolloutSpec as JSON.
- `state` (String) Actual server-owned Rollout state.
- `status_json` (String) Server-owned progress and terminal-result projection as JSON. Includes `entitlement_warning` (with `grace_until`) while the plugin licence is in its grace period and `entitlement_suspension` (licence state, `suspended_at`, `resume_available`) while the Rollout is paused because Core stopped allowing forward work.
